LightningComponentBundle.description: Objections raised against a provider, unioned across the Visit Objection junction and legacy activity capture.

property.name: monthsBack
property.label: Date window (months)
property.description: 0 means all time, which is the default. There is no date filter on the list, so a rolling window here would hide older objections with no way to reveal them.

property.name: rowLimit
property.label: Row limit
property.description: Maximum objections to load. Capped at 2000 by the controller.

property.name: showNotes
property.label: Show notes column
property.description: Uncheck to hide objection notes from the table.
